name: keeper-app-author
description: Describe how you or your team works and get a real app for it — notes, records, boards, dashboards, and workflows — with every change reviewed before it goes live.

interface.longDescription:
Describe how you work — what you track, who does what, a normal week — and Keeper App Author builds a real app for it: a personal tracker or notebook, or shared customer and job records, boards, dashboards, and the workflows that tie them together. More capable than a spreadsheet, at a fraction of the time and cost of custom software or an ERP — live on desktop and mobile, in the same MechaBee workspace as your files, chats, and agents.

Great for one person turning captured ideas into next actions, and for small teams running day-to-day operations. Start from a plain-language brief or improve an app you already run. Every change is shown to you as a clear before/after that you approve before it goes live, and your existing records are protected by default. Change how you work? Describe the change and the app follows — no admin console, no development queue.
capabilities: Build a working app from a plain-language description
Personal trackers or shared team records — boards, dashboards, and workflows
Workflows and in-app agent actions that work on your data
Improve and fix apps you already run, without losing data
Review every change before it goes live
Live on desktop and mobile — open it with one click
defaultPrompt: Turn my scattered notes into a personal tracker with tasks, statuses, and a weekly review.
Build a service dispatch board with customer and equipment records and a parts list.
Add an approval step and a status dashboard to my app, and show me exactly what changes before it goes live.
